title: 26 CFR 1.709-1, Treatment of organization and syndication costs (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: Should any organization cost amortization appear this year under section 709?
passages.excerpt: an electing partnership may deduct an amount equal to the lesser of the amount of the organizational expenses of the partnership, or $5,000 (reduced (but not below zero) by the amount by which the organizational expenses exceed $50,000).
